description: Query a key that was never inserted and assert the returned value is exactly null.
Query a key that was never inserted and assert the operation throws an exception.
Surround a valid input with leading and trailing whitespace and assert it behaves like the unpadded input.
Add leading or trailing whitespace and assert it changes the interpreted value.
Insert with one letter case, query with another, and assert both address the same key.
Insert spellings that differ only by letter case and assert they remain separate keys.
Provide otherwise valid positive and negative tokens with explicit signs and assert both are accepted.
Provide a token with an explicit sign and assert it is rejected as malformed.
Provide a range whose first endpoint is greater and assert output proceeds downward through both endpoints.
Provide a range whose first endpoint is greater and assert the range is rejected.
Repeat a result later in the input and assert only its first occurrence remains in first-occurrence order.
Repeat a result later in the input and assert the last occurrence determines its output position.
